chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from Hammad, from Hariz, from one who informed him, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
If the dog laps from the vessel, then pour it out.

key_terms.الْإِنَاءِ: the vessel or container holding the liquid
key_terms.الْكَلْبُ: the dog, whose contact here affects purity rulings
key_terms.فَصُبَّهُ: then pour it out; discard its contents
key_terms.وَلَغَ: lapped with the tongue from a liquid or vessel

ai.seo_question: What should be done if a dog laps from a vessel according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning ritual purity and the ruling of a vessel from which a dog has lapped. It instructs that the contents of such a vessel should be poured out, indicating impurity and its practical consequence in fiqh.
